sites.description: Pixegen - makers of modern communication tools. News, updates, and notes from the team behind uRSS.
sites.home_text:
Makers of modern tools. 
Pixegen builds simple, focused apps that help you stay connected to what matters — starting with uRSS, our RSS reader for iOS. 
Our Apps 
PixelLoupe 
macOS • Raw • Open source 
A raw photo editor and catalog for the Mac, built for photographers coming from Lightroom Classic and Aperture. Bring your catalog and presets, keep your shortcuts. Free and open source. 
 Learn more → 
Ultravault 
Mac • iPhone • iPad • Vault 
A locked vault for logins, passkeys, cards, receipts, and the sensitive bits of life. Encrypted with CryptoKit on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad, synced through your own iCloud only if you say so. Coming soon. 
 Learn more → 
uRSS for iOS 
iOS • Swift • RSS 
A fast, focused RSS reader for iPhone. Organize feeds into groups, swipe to mark read or favorite, and read comfortably in light or dark mode - no accounts, no algorithms, just your feeds. 
 Learn more → 
uRSS for Mac 
macOS • Swift • RSS 
Your RSS feeds and podcasts on the desktop, in a true three-pane Mac app. Folders, smart favorites, muted words and a Now Playing window - fast, local and private, with no accounts and no cloud. 
 Learn more → 
uRSS for Android 
Android • Kotlin • RSS 
The same fast, focused RSS reading experience, built natively for Android. Groups, gestures, and light or dark themes - everything you love about uRSS, on your Android phone. 
 Get on the Play Store 
BrowserSwap 
macOS • Menu bar • Utility 
Switch your Mac’s default browser in one click from the menu bar. Finds the browsers you’ve actually installed, optional schedules, no account — actually free. 
 Learn more →
